# QR encoder

`../qr-encoder.js` is the unmodified standalone JavaScript QR Code Generator by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licensed. No package manager, framework, CDN or external QR generation service is used. The full license is in `qrcode.LICENSE.txt`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

- Source: `js/dist/qrcode.js`
- SHA-256: `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c`

Avela renders the returned matrix as an inline black/white SVG with a four-module quiet zone. Provisioning data stays on the private enrollment page and is not sent to the upstream project. Review updates deliberately and preserve this attribution/license. QR decoding fixtures are private test tooling, not runtime dependencies.
